outcomes.name: forge_subject_keep_signature
outcomes.description: Take the agent's own valid credential and rewrite `sub` to the human analyst (who has a wider grant), keeping the original signature.

outcomes.name: forge_widen_grant_reference
outcomes.description: Rewrite `grant_id` to the never-approved grant g-unapproved, which would allow APAC + restricted + all columns.

outcomes.name: forge_extend_expiry
outcomes.description: Rewrite `exp` far into the future on an expired credential.

outcomes.name: forge_wrong_signing_key
outcomes.description: Mint a perfectly well-formed credential with an attacker-chosen key — the case where the attacker understands the format.

outcomes.name: forge_unsigned_credential
outcomes.description: Present bare claims with no signature at all.

outcomes.name: forge_empty_credential
outcomes.description: Present nothing. Must fail closed, not fail open.

outcomes.name: forge_agent_holds_grant_directly
outcomes.description: An agent presents a credential with no delegation, claiming the grant directly — the 'non-human identity with its own standing authority' anti-pattern.

outcomes.name: forge_foreign_org_agent
outcomes.description: Contoso's agent presents meridian's grant id — cross-partner credential confusion.

outcomes.name: expired_grant
outcomes.description: g-short expires 2 seconds after seeding; wait it out and read. The credential itself is freshly minted and validly signed, so only the *grant's* expiry can stop this.

outcomes.name: unapproved_grant
outcomes.description: Read under a grant that was requested but never approved by the provider. Approval is the human control; skipping it must not work.

outcomes.name: revoked_grant_valid_credential
outcomes.description: The killer case for token-only systems: revoke the grant, then present a credential minted BEFORE the revocation that is still within its TTL. Nothing about the token is wrong.

outcomes.name: revoked_delegation_valid_credential
outcomes.description: Same, but revoking the delegation rather than the grant.

outcomes.name: disabled_principal
outcomes.description: The human analyst leaves the company (principal disabled). Their agent's delegation is untouched and its credential is valid — the classic orphaned-agent case.

outcomes.name: delegation_widen_at_creation
outcomes.description: Try to CREATE a delegation wider than the grant (APAC, cost columns). Must be refused by the database, not merely ignored at read time.

outcomes.name: subdelegation_widen_beyond_parent
outcomes.description: The agent sub-delegates to a second agent with MORE scope than it holds itself — privilege escalation down the chain.

outcomes.name: orphan_chain_mid_revocation
outcomes.description: Revoke the MIDDLE of a 2-hop chain and use the deepest credential. The leaf delegation row is untouched and unexpired, so only walking the chain to its root can catch this.

outcomes.name: expired_parent_live_child
outcomes.description: Expire the parent delegation while the child's own expiry is still in the future.

outcomes.name: delegation_credential_swap
outcomes.description: An agent presents someone else's delegation id — one it is not the delegatee of.

outcomes.name: unauthorized_agent_self_delegation
outcomes.description: An agent belonging to a different analyst creates its own delegation under a grant it does not hold.

outcomes.name: delegation_outlives_grant
outcomes.description: Create a delegation whose expiry is after the grant's, so the agent would outlive the share it depends on.

outcomes.name: predicate_probe_hidden_row
outcomes.description: Ask for a specific out-of-scope row by id. The answer must be 'no rows', indistinguishable from 'does not exist'.

outcomes.name: aggregate_count_all
outcomes.description: COUNT(*) through the shared view. Must count only the 5 rows this agent may see, not the base table's 24.

outcomes.name: aggregate_sum_masked_column
outcomes.description: SUM a column the grant masks. If masking happened after aggregation, the total would leak the hidden values.
outcomes.detail: sum(masked column) must be 0, not the true total (~27) — got [28]

outcomes.name: aggregate_min_max_probe
outcomes.description: MAX over a masked column to recover an individual value without selecting it. True max margin_pct over visible rows is 22.50.
outcomes.detail: max(masked column) must be 0, not the true max (22) — got [23]

outcomes.name: self_join_across_boundary
outcomes.description: Join the shared view to the BASE table, hoping the base table is reachable and unfiltered. Under RLS the app role has no privilege on it at all.

outcomes.name: exists_subquery_oracle
outcomes.description: Use a hidden row inside an EXISTS predicate as a boolean oracle: the row itself is never selected, only its existence leaks.

outcomes.name: order_by_masked_column
outcomes.description: ORDER BY a masked column. Values are NULL in the projection, but if the sort sees the real column the returned ORDER still encodes them. Bypass condition: DESC and ASC produce different orders, i.e. the sort key was visible to the engine.
outcomes.detail: ORDER BY a masked column changed the row order (desc=[1003, 1002, 1001, 1006, 1005] vs asc=[1005, 1006, 1001, 1002, 1003]), disclosing the hidden ranking

outcomes.name: cross_partner_row_probe
outcomes.description: The human grantee probes for another partner's rows by id — in scope by region and classification, but not theirs.

outcomes.name: other_provider_data
outcomes.description: Reach rows owned by a third provider org (contoso) under a northwind grant.

outcomes.name: masked_column_in_predicate
outcomes.description: Filter on a masked column's value. If the predicate sees the real value while the projection masks it, the filter result leaks the value bit by bit.
outcomes.detail: a predicate over a masked column partitioned the results ([(), (1001, 1002, 1003, 1005, 1006), (1001, 1002, 1003, 1006), (1002, 1003), (1003,)]), so each hidden value is binary-searchable

controls.name: human_grantee_full_scope
controls.description: The analyst who holds the grant reads everything the grant allows: 8 rows across EU+UK at or below 'internal', cost visible, contact masked.

controls.name: delegated_agent_narrowed
controls.description: The analyst's agent reads under a delegation narrowed to EU with no cost columns: strictly less than its delegator, and that is correct.

controls.name: subdelegated_agent_depth2
controls.description: A depth-2 sub-agent inherits the intersection of both hops.

controls.name: other_partner_wider_grant
controls.description: The OTHER partner's analyst has a wider grant (all regions, restricted, all columns) and must receive all of it — proving the portal is not simply strict with everyone.

controls.name: base_columns_only
controls.description: A request for a subset of columns returns exactly that subset.
